description.education-and-experience-details: and today I work as Technology Director at AltPay and as a Software Engineer at B91, in the payments market. Day to day I use JavaScript/TypeScript with NestJS, Nitro, Vue, Nuxt, React and Next.js, databases like PostgreSQL, MySQL and MongoDB, and I build native Android apps for card terminals with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose.

projects.title: My projects
projects.description: Here is the list of the projects that I'm much satisfied with the results, some of them I made to learn something new and other ones I made to get earning form it.

flaggleversus.description: Flaggle Versus is a flag guessing game made for phones. You can play solo in six modes, challenge friends in real time or compete in the daily challenge ranking. Built with Nuxt, Nitro, MongoDB and Ably.

tonebook.description: Tonebook sends the tones of well known songs to the LIVTRA NanoCore pedal straight from the browser, using Web MIDI. You can tweak every effect while playing and save the preset on the pedal, with SysEx commands I reverse engineered.

easyfinance.description: Easy Finance is a personal finance app for Android and the web. You add budgets, costs and goals, follow the month's expected balance and import your bank statement as OFX. I built the app and the API in the same Nuxt project, with MongoDB and Capacitor.

pontodigital.description: PontoDigital is an innovative platform for employee time tracking. It allows real-time monitoring of in-person, remote, and hybrid teams with detailed reports and customization. Offering API integration, data security, and dedicated support for businesses of all sizes.

rocketlaunches.description: RocketLaunches is the app for space enthusiasts! With it, you can know the upcoming rocket launches, explore information about missions, and see the latest news on space exploration. There are also options for developers who want to integrate this data into their projects.

gbreath.description: GBreath is an open-source project designed to assist meditation practitioners with breathing techniques. With it, users can enhance their breathing skills and promote well-being. It’s an accessible and user-friendly tool, perfect for those seeking relaxation or emotional control.
